{{Quote|Okay, Boba, the cargo is secure.|Latts Razzi|<ref name="Bounty" />}}
'''Latts Razzi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At some point in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], she was affiliated with [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], [[C-21 Highsinger/Legends|C-21 Highsinger]], and [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]]. Her main weapon was a scaled [[Grappling boa/Legends|grappling boa]] which, when used, snapped like a whip or lariat and was being used to grapple enemies. She also had a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]], but did not use it as much as her whip. She was one of the bounty hunters during the [[Safe cargo objective/Legends|job]] on [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]] to help deliver cargo to [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]].

Shortly after this mission, Razzi was with [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. This coincided with [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] being on [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]] in search of his [[Darth Maul/Legends|brother]].

Sometime later, Razzi was on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] under the employ of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. When [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] leader [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] came seeking an alliance, the meeting did not go too well and the three retreated. Razzi was part of the team present that pursued the three.

==Biography==
{{Quote|She's a little rough around the edges, but we need ''six'' hunters. Without her, we got no job.|Latts Razzi, on [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="Bounty" />}}
Latts Razzi was a bounty hunter during the Clone Wars. During that time, Latts joined a team of bounty hunters under the leadership of [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Razzi, along with fellow team members [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and [[Oked/Legends|Oked]], went to [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]. After seeing Oked killed by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], she and Bossk decide to invite her for drink and told her if she didn't join their team to fill in for Oked, they'd turn her to the authorities. Razzi and Bossk then took her to meet Fett and the others to take part in a [[Safe cargo objective/Legends|job]] on [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]].

[[File:Latts_Razzi_XW.png|thumb|left|220px|Razzi accepts a bounty on the Rodian, [[Omar Toggs/Legends|Omar Toggs]]]]
The group was tasked with guarding a large wooden chest aboard a [[Subtram/Legends|subtram]], which was to be delivered to the planet's dictator [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]]. Though the trip began easily enough, soon the tram was beset by [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]], who sought the cargo for themselves. One by one, the hunters where tossed from the train by the warriors. Though Razzi was one of the last hunters standing, the Warriors' leader, [[Krismo Sodi/Legends|Krismo Sodi]], was able to dispatch her when she mistakenly [[Grappling boa/Legends|grappled]] [[C-21 Highsinger/Legends|C-21 Highsinger]]. Sodi kicked Highsinger off the train and Razzi was pulled off with him.

In their absence, Fett was also bested by Sodi, who soon revealed that the cargo was his sister, [[Pluma Sodi/Legends|Pluma Sodi]], who was to be forcibly wed to Blank. Ventress, having suffered many changes in her recent past, ended up placing Fett within the chest and selling him to Blank, collecting both a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] from the warlord as well as from the Kage Warriors for freeing Pluma. She then shared the first bounty with Razzi and the others, telling them that Fett would join them soon enough.<ref name="Bounty" />

Razzi was later seen back at Chalmun's sharing a table with Ventress and was worried that her new associate was on edge.<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref>

Sometime later, Razzi was on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] under the employ of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. When [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] leader [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] came seeking an alliance, the meeting did not go too well. Jabba summoned his bounty hunters, Razzi included, to attack. Vizsla [[Flamethrower/Legends|set fire]] to the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|council]] table in order for Maul's group to escape. The bounty hunters chased them onto the landing platform where they were winning the fight until [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan]] and more [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] soldiers showed up, forcing the bounty hunters to retreat back inside.

Once inside, the bounty hunters tried to take down Maul, Opress, and Vizsla but the three were too powerful. Defeated, Razzi and [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] tossed [[Smoke grenade/Legends|smoke grenades]] down the hall to cover the escape of their fellow bounty hunters [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]], and [[Marrok (anooba)/Legends|Marrok]]. Razzi and the others fled the [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] and Maul allowed them to leave as they were only bounty hunters.<ref name="Eminence (episode)">{{TCW|Eminence (episode)}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:LattsRazziDetail-SWE.png|thumb|right|160px|Latts Razzi, with her grappling boa]]
{{Quote|Who cares? As long as we get paid.|Latts Razzi expresses her indifference about the job to Bossk|<ref name="Bounty" />}}
Razzi was shown to be indifferent to the job at hand as long as she got paid. However, she also showed some concern about her fellow [[Bounty hunter/Legends|hunters]] as shown when she worried about the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]-turned-bounty hunter [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].

==Talents and abilities==
Latts was proficient in hand-to-hand combat, as shown when she fought against the [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]], and in the use of her [[Grappling boa/Legends|grappling boa]], a weapon as of yet unique to her.

==Behind the scenes==
Latts Razzi was voiced by [[Clare Grant]] in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] episodes "[[Bounty (episode)|Bounty]]" and "[[Brothers (episode)|Brothers]]," and the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] episode "[[Eminence (episode)|Eminence]]" of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']].
